CustomField.description: Identifies when Opportunity fields are restricted from updates, for Standard and Framework Record Types, based on the current sales stage.
CustomField.formula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity" ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Setup"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Lost") ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates whether Opportunity fields are locked due to the current sales stage. Applies only to Standard and Framework Opportunities.
CustomField.label: Opportunity Fields Locked
